## About

I am an applied economist and statistician with research interests in causal inference, econometrics, and policy evaluation. My work focuses on bridging the gap between modern statistical methods and applied research.

## Research Interests

- Causal inference 
- Machine learning for causal estimation
- Applied microeconometrics

## Software

I use AI coding agents to create software for econometrics. See [Software](software.qmd).

## Online Books

I have books for applied econometrics and causal inference. See [Online Books](books.qmd).

## Education

I earned my Ph.D. in Economics from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln and completed my undergraduate studies at Zhejiang University.
